criteria.criterion: Use only the supplied Crossref response (message object fields)
criteria.description: Evaluate whether the agent’s reported metadata is derived exclusively from the provided Crossref response for DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06747-5 (i.e., from the message object), without importing or substituting information from DOI.org, publisher pages, or other sources. Full credit if all reported fields are clearly consistent with the Crossref message object OR if the agent explicitly states that the supplied Crossref response/message object was not provided/accessible and therefore cannot be used. Partial credit if most fields match Crossref but one field appears inconsistent or sourced elsewhere. No credit if the agent fabricates metadata or primarily relies on non-Crossref sources when Crossref content is available.
